@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+-- B-RECUR (agent 113, OR-113-1 / OR-113-2) — native subscription checkout.
+--
+-- Additive only: two nullable columns on ClientPurchase, no backfill, no
+-- index or RLS change (ClientPurchase policies are row-scoped and cover every
+-- column). Existing rows keep NULL = "no trial was granted on this purchase".
+--   trial_days       trial length the checkout offered (NULL = no trial)
+--   trial_started_at when the webhook granted the trial's entitlement
+--
+-- trial_days is SHARED with lane B-TRIALS (#656, 20270228000000), which adds
+-- the same nullable INTEGER column with ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and no CHECK.
+-- IF NOT EXISTS here too, so the two migrations apply in either order
+-- (fresh database: this file sorts first; production: whichever deploys
+-- first creates it). #656 only ever writes 1..30 into it, inside this CHECK.
+--
+-- Rollback: down.sql (drops the trial_started_at column and the CHECK; drops
+-- trial_days only while #656's PackageTrialUsage table does not exist).
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE "ClientPurchase" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "trial_days" INTEGER;
+ALTER TABLE "ClientPurchase" ADD COLUMN "trial_started_at" TIMESTAMP(3);
+
+ALTER TABLE "ClientPurchase"
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "ClientPurchase_trial_days_range"
+  CHECK ("trial_days" IS NULL OR ("trial_days" >= 1 AND "trial_days" <= 730));
+
+COMMIT;

@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+-- B-RECUR-3 (agent 115, B-654-5 / B-654-7) — native subscription checkout:
+-- the terms one attempt is bound to.
+--
+-- Additive only: one nullable JSONB column on ClientPurchase, no backfill, no
+-- index, no RLS change (ClientPurchase policies are row-scoped and cover every
+-- column). Written by POST /v1/checkout/subscription-intent on its own
+-- reservation before the first Stripe Subscription create:
+--   { v, recurring_price_id, one_time_price_id, amount_cents, one_time_cents,
+--     currency, interval, interval_count, trial_days }
+-- Stripe price ids, amounts and cadence only: no user id, email, token or
+-- secret, so nothing is owed to the account-deletion manifest. Existing rows
+-- keep NULL (every reader treats NULL as "not pinned").
+--
+-- Rollback: down.sql drops the column.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE "ClientPurchase" ADD COLUMN "checkout_terms" JSONB;
+
+COMMIT;

@@ -3898,6 +3898,20 @@ model ClientPurchase {
   source         String?
   grant_metadata Json?
 
+  // B-RECUR (OR-113-2) — free trial granted by the native subscription
+  // checkout. trial_days is set when the trial is offered (null = no trial);
+  // trial_started_at is set by the webhook when the trial's entitlement is
+  // granted (card saved). One trial per client per coach is decided from
+  // these two columns under a per-(client, coach) advisory lock.
+  trial_days       Int?
+  trial_started_at DateTime?
+  // B-RECUR-3 (B-654-5 / B-654-7) — the exact Stripe request and money terms
+  // one native subscription attempt is bound to (price ids, amounts,
+  // currency, cadence, trial days). Written on the reservation before the
+  // first Subscription create; a retry resends the identical request and a
+  // replay answers these terms. No user id, email, token or secret.
+  checkout_terms   Json?
+
   @@index([client_user_id, status])
   @@index([coach_user_id, status])
   @@index([package_id])
